title: PvPToggle
description: PvPToggle is a lightweight utility plugin for Paper servers that gives players control over their PvP status. Players can toggle PvP on or off using simple commands. Perfect for servers that want easy player-controlled PvP toggling.
body:
A lightweight PvP toggle plugin for Paper servers that lets players easily enable or disable PvP at any time using simple commands.

Perfect for SMP and survival servers where players want control over when they can engage in combat without needing complicated setups or plugins.

Supports permission-based access and saves player settings between sessions for a smooth and reliable experience.

Features
- Toggle PvP on/off instantly
- Simple and easy-to-use commands
- Permission support
- Saves player settings
- Lightweight and performance-friendly
